title: Check Against Reference
text: Check that model signal tracks reference signal during simulation, 1 input, 1 output, {Times} sets Time vector; {Show Plot} sets the open plot window, {Show plot on block open} sets the double-click block to open plot, {Response Optimization} sets the open Response Optimizer, {Include reference signal tracking in assertion} sets the check that signal tracks reference signal, {Amplitudes} sets the reference signal amplitude 1-exp, {Absolute tolerance}, {Relative tolerance}, {Enable assertion} enables or disable check, {Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)} sets the expression to evaluate when assertion, {Stop simulation when assertion fails} sets the halt simulation when assertion fails and {Output assertion signal} sets the create output signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1 (u)
ports.summary: Signal to check against specified reference signal scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Show plot on block open
params.values: Double-click block to open plot off (default) | on

params.name: Include reference signal tracking in assertion
params.values: Check that signal tracks reference signal on (default) | off

params.name: Times
params.values: Time vector linspace(0,10) (default) | vector of positive values | MATLAB expression

params.name: Amplitudes
params.values: Reference signal amplitude 1-exp(-linspace(0,10)/2) (default) | vector | MATLAB expression

params.name: Absolute tolerance
params.values: Absolute tolerance for signal eps^(1/3) (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Relative tolerance
params.values: Relative tolerance for signal 0.01 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Enable assertion
params.values: Enable or disable check on (default) | off

params.name: Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)
params.values: Expression to evaluate when assertion fails ’’ (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Stop simulation when assertion fails
params.values: Halt simulation when assertion fails off (default) | on
